profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I worked full time for seven years as an application developer. On top of my professional experience as an application developer both in Android and IOS, I spent a large amount of my time in school interfacing embedded systems with web or mobile applications. I enjoy working with both software and hardware and believe that I would be a helpful addition to companies looking to create applications for things like data analysis, data transmission, and user interfaces.

positions.title: Android & IOS Developer
positions.description: Worked remotely from Washington as a freelance programmer developing for the Android and IOS platforms.

positions.title: Android & IOS Developer
positions.description: Developed, successfully shipped, and maintained a variety of applications that had more than 35,000 users on average.
